responsibility: Implementation of RTL SSA instruction-change analysis and application support. This file prints insn_change descriptions, validates proposed edits against movement and hard-register conflicts, computes old versus new instruction costs, runs recognition of modified RTL patterns, and performs queued post-change updates such as CFG repairs, dead-edge purging, and jump-label rebuilds.
same_name_distinction: Implements the mechanics behind insn_change from changes.h: validating batches of edits, computing replacement costs, re-recognizing RTL patterns with clobber adjustments, and applying queued CFG/jump updates; unlike changes.h, it is the operational engine for checking and carrying out proposed instruction changes.
